name: Order's Wrath
description: Deals (min(CASTERLEVEL,10)/2)d8 damage to chaotic creatures ((min(CASTERLEVEL,10))d6 to chaotic outsiders) and dazes them 1 round; Will save halves damage and negates daze. Neutral creatures take half damage (Will quarters); lawful creatures unaffected.
area: Nonlawful creatures within a burst that fills a 30-ft. cube
